# Vendored build dependencies

The normal `main` branch includes FTXUI v7.0.3 in `ftxui/` under the MIT
license. Its source is from the upstream `v7.0.3` release. The `debug` branch
also includes doctest v2.4.12 under its MIT license for offline unit tests.

Keep each upstream license file with its source. `build/` and other generated
files are not part of the vendored source.
